description: Turn a word or a short title into eye-catching word art on the board. Type up to three lines, then pick a style (Retro 3D, Neon, Chrome, Outline, Bubble or Rainbow wave), a font (Bungee, Pacifico, Righteous, Anton or Rubik Mono One), its colours, an arc and a size, and place it as a transparent image. Select it later to change the words or the style and update it in place.
